gloss: biased view; seeing through rose-colored glasses

definitions.gloss: biased view; partial perspective; seeing favorably due to personal attachment
definitions.explanation: Looking at something or someone in an overly favorable way because of personal fondness, loyalty, or connection. Acknowledges that one's judgment may not be objective.

examples.english: Even looking at it with bias, it's a stretch.

examples.japanese: {贔屓目|ひいきめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{引|ひ}いて→差し引く：06701_sashihiku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしかった→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
examples.english: Even discounting my bias, his performance was wonderful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{贔屓目|ひいきめ}⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: It might be parental bias, but I think our child has talent.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used self-deprecatingly to acknowledge one's own bias, or to suggest that someone else's positive assessment may not be objective.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {贔屓目|ひいきめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even looking at it favorably)
- {贔屓目|ひいきめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{引|ひ}いて→差し引く：06701_sashihiku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even discounting the bias)
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{贔屓目|ひいきめ} (parental bias)

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{贔屓|ひいき}→贔屓：10490_hiiki⟧ (favoritism, patronage) + ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye, view). Literally "eyes of favoritism."
